summary: Add a local ancestor ownership witness for native-session adoption research

schema.detail: No persisted or wire formats change.

rules.detail: No authorization path is added or relaxed. The witness proves same-UID process ancestry, not native-session identity or adoption authority.

compatibility.detail: The Rust runtime library adds PeerProcessIdentity::verify_ancestor on Linux and macOS. It pins a caller ancestor and revalidates parent links, effective UIDs and birth tokens. Existing callers and CLI behavior are unchanged; there is no adoption command yet.

downtime.detail: No service or harness restart is required for existing behavior.

manual.detail: No operator action. A future adoption integration must independently prove the current native session and authorize binding before using this witness.

recovery.detail: Revert the library addition; no bindings or durable state are created.
